g.text: M2 / E2: the same candidate requests encounter different admission constraints
16 short (512/64) + 4 long (8192/64); dots: all 5 repetitions. Identical paired inputs; two submission orders.
Native capacity checks retained. Instant-share is a diagnostic comparator, not an equal-fairness SOTA baseline.
